title: Our First Coffee
story: I was so nervous, my hands were literally shaking. But the moment you walked in and smiled, all my fears dissolved. We talked for hours about everything and nothing...

title: Beach Sunset Walk
story: The sea breeze was cool, and the sky turned into a canvas of pink and orange. As we walked barefoot on the wet sand, you took my hand for the first time, and it felt like home.

title: Under the Stars
story: Away from the city lights, we laid on a blanket and looked up at the Milky Way. A shooting star passed by, but I didn't need to make a wish—my wish was already lying next to me.

title: First Movie Date
story: We went to see a scary movie just so you could hold my arm. I pretended to be brave, but truth is, my heart was racing faster because of how close you were.

title: First Birthday Together
story: Celebrating your birthday under fairy lights. You looked absolutely stunning, like a princess. Seeing the joy in your eyes when blowing the candles is a memory I'll treasure forever.

title: The Promise of Forever
story: As the new year fireworks lit up the sky, we made a silent promise to stay by each other's side. No matter what comes, it's you and me against the world. Always.
